create_OptimizeMix: create an OptimizeMix instance to simulate least-cost energy mix optimization for a given time horizon in hours
run_OptimizeMix: run the OptimizeMix loss function with optimization parameters to evaluate energy mix cost under constraints

test_OptimizeMix: test the OptimizeMix experiment function by instantiating it with a custom time parameter and calling its loss function
summarize_OptimizeMix: summarize the OptimizeMix class which wraps MixSimulator for nevergrad benchmark experiments on energy mix optimization
